text.title: Delivery team, 6 people, agreed 1 September 2026
text.purpose: slot reminders live for 50% of buyers; progress checked every day
text.when: 10:00 every day, video call link pinned in the team chat
text.people: 6 people: 4 developers, QA and the product lead
text.facilitator: Scrum master Ilya; the role rotates each sprint
text.agenda: By board: blocked cards first, then cards in review, then the rest by priority
text.prep: Each person moves their cards on the board by 09:50 and marks blockers
text.offline: Topics over 2 minutes go offline; the people involved stay after the call
text.outcome: Plan for the day and help requests, recorded in the team chat
text.check: Length measured weekly; usefulness asked in the retro, reviewed each sprint
text.decision: From 1 October: a 15-minute cap, blockers first, and no status round
